TS0420001.message: The store holds system data at version {installed}, which is newer than this build supports (up to {supported}).
TS0420001.solution: Start a build at or above the one that wrote it. Downgrading across a system-data version is not supported; to go back, restore the backup taken before the upgrade.

TS0420002.message: Another member ({holder}) has been migrating the system data since {since} and has not finished.
TS0420002.solution: Check that member is still running. If it has died, this one takes over on its own once the lock goes stale; if it is stuck, stop it and start this one again.

TS0420003.solution: Fix what the cause names, then start again -- the migration resumes at this changeset rather than repeating the ones before it.
